title: Beyond-Light
content: Beyond-Light is a research and simulation project whose documentation, browser application, Java/Android source, datasets, workflows, tests, and source archive are now preserved as a versioned source snapshot in the Knowledge branch. Its research archive is also represented in the curated beyond-light knowledge collection. The source repository could not be resolved on GitHub at transfer time; this local snapshot preserves the project files, not its Git history.

source.extraction_method: User-directed snapshot of clean local main worktree; Git metadata and generated build output excluded
